ASNR 700.description: Introduction to foundational concepts in nurse anesthesia and the role of the nurse anesthetist.
ASNR 700.subject: ASNR
ASNR 700.title: Introduction to Nurse Anesthesia Practice

ASNR 702.description: This course is designed to further explore the Doctor of Nurse Anesthesia Practice degree to include the roles of the CRNA in relation to the patient, the profession, and the health care system.
ASNR 702.subject: ASNR
ASNR 702.title: Professional Roles and Scholarship for the DNAP

ASNR 704.description: Guided development for the SRNA in the scholarly project, on-campus program requirements, and clinical preparation.
ASNR 704.subject: ASNR
ASNR 704.title: Nurse Anesthesia Doctoral Student Development

ASNR 710.description: Fundamentals in research and statistics with emphasis on statistics, research methods, and evaluation of current anesthesia research, to prepare the learner for topics relevant to the Doctorate in Nurse Anesthesia.
ASNR 710.subject: ASNR
ASNR 710.title: Statistical and Research Methods for the DNAP

ASNR 720.description: This course provides instruction and practice in the techniques necessary to assess health and to evaluate symptoms to identify disease.
ASNR 720.subject: ASNR
ASNR 720.title: Advanced Comprehensive Health Assessment

ASNR 724.description: Leadership in nurse anesthesia practice and complex health organizations.
ASNR 724.subject: ASNR
ASNR 724.title: Leadership in Nurse Anesthesia Practice

ASNR 750.description: Historical and current concepts in health policy, ethics, and legal concepts for the DNAP Nurse Anesthetist.
ASNR 750.subject: ASNR
ASNR 750.title: Health Policy, Ethics, and Legal Concepts for the DNAP Nurse Anesthetist

ASNR 752.description: An overview of varied health system theories, emphasizing the role of the nurse anesthetist in contributing to patient care within these systems.
ASNR 752.subject: ASNR
ASNR 752.title: Health Systems for the Nurse Anesthetist

ASNR 754.description: Student will explore health informatics and health information management principles – particularly as applicable to the nurse anesthetist’s role in the healthcare system and to data management for research and practice improvement.
ASNR 754.subject: ASNR
ASNR 754.title: Health Care Informatics for the Nurse Anesthetist

ASNR 760.description: Introduction to pain management concepts and the use of ultrasound guided techniques in treatment.
ASNR 760.subject: ASNR
ASNR 760.title: Clinical Topics in Nurse Anesthesia Practice I

ASNR 761.description: Application of basic anesthesia principles to the practice of nurse anesthesia.
ASNR 761.subject: ASNR
ASNR 761.title: Basic Anesthesia Principles I

ASNR 762.description: This course is a continuation of Basic Principles in Anesthesia I, covering beginning concepts in nurse anesthesia practice.
ASNR 762.subject: ASNR
ASNR 762.title: Basic Anesthesia Principles II

ASNR 763.description: This course covers advanced concepts in nurse anesthesia practice.
ASNR 763.subject: ASNR
ASNR 763.title: Advanced Principles in Nurse Anesthesia Practice

ASNR 771.description: This course provides a thorough orientation to the clinical area and application of beginning anesthesia concepts to patients through simulation and precepted in-hospital assignments.

ASNR 771.title: Introduction to Nurse Anesthesia Practicum

ASNR 772.description: Students will present a critique of anesthetic management of selected cases or topics related to their doctoral project in anesthesia for peer review. A review of the literature and application of the current research is to be included in the presentations.
ASNR 772.subject: ASNR
ASNR 772.title: Seminar in Nurse Anesthesia I

ASNR 773.description: The first of five clinical practicums focusing on general anesthesia.
ASNR 773.subject: ASNR
ASNR 773.title: Clinical Practicum I

ASNR 775.description: The second of five clinical field experiences including general and specialty anesthesia rotations.
ASNR 775.subject: ASNR
ASNR 775.title: Clinical Practicum II

ASNR 777.description: The third of five clinical field experiences including general and specialty anesthesia rotations.
ASNR 777.subject: ASNR
ASNR 777.title: Clinical Practicum III

ASNR 779.description: The fourth of five clinical field experiences including general and specialty anesthesia rotations.
ASNR 779.subject: ASNR
ASNR 779.title: Clinical Practicum IV

ASNR 781.description: The fifth of five clinical field experiences including general and specialty anesthesia rotations.
ASNR 781.subject: ASNR
ASNR 781.title: Clinical Practicum V

ASNR 795.description: Application of physical and chemical concepts to the practice of nurse anesthesia.
ASNR 795.subject: ASNR
ASNR 795.title: Application of Physical and Chemical Concepts in Nurse Anesthesia Practice

ASNR 797.description: This course addresses the professional role responsibilities, challenges and issues for nurse anesthetists.
ASNR 797.subject: ASNR
ASNR 797.title: Professional Role of the DNAP Nurse Anesthetist I

ASNR 798.description: Application of physiology and pathophysiology to nurse anesthesia practice.
ASNR 798.subject: ASNR
ASNR 798.title: Application of Biomedical Concepts in Nurse Anesthesia Practice

ASNR 800.description: Review of concepts with the purpose of creating broad view connections of anesthesia principles.
ASNR 800.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: ASNR 761, ASNR 762, ASNR 763, ASNR 795, ASNR 798.
ASNR 800.subject: ASNR
ASNR 800.title: Integration of Concepts Across Nurse Anesthesia Practice

ASNR 801.description: Use of simulation to learn and practice various peripheral nerve blocks and airway block placement with ultrasound and nerve stimulator techniques. Preparatory work outside of simulation time is required.
ASNR 801.subject: ASNR
ASNR 801.title: Specialty Focus Simulation I

ASNR 802.description: High fidelity simulation activities to practice response to critical events in nurse anesthesia practice. Preparatory work outside of simulation is required.

ASNR 802.title: Specialty Focus Simulation II

ASNR 824.title: Evidence-Based Decisions and Nurse Anesthesia

ASNR 860.title: Clinical Topics in Nurse Anesthesia Practice II

ASNR 896.description: Education, management, and business principles, as they relate to the DNAP Nurse Anesthetist, will be explored and practiced.
